title: Autopilot State
x_note: The durable on-disk arming state (BL-011). Read fail-safe: any read error -> treated as OFF. Only the PM arms; expiry is fixed 05:30 SGT (D-7a).

deployment.description: which deployment holds the arm — only ONE may be armed for live at a time (D-19); Kimi cannot arm until production migration (D-30)
